cli.help.models.after:
Usage: deckent models [--json] [--lang en|tr] [--no-color]
Lists configured model declarations. Availability is not observed.
  models binding|activation|activate|deactivate --help
  models invoke|invocation|purge-content|spending|audit-spending --input <file|-> [--json]
Invoke, invocation, purge-content, spending, and audit-spending require an explicitly started local `deckent runtime serve`. A runtime-owned invocation continues if the client disconnects; retrying the same command identity returns its receipt and does not resend the native request.

cli.help.modelsInvocation.before:
deckent models invoke|invocation --input <file|-> [--json] [--lang en|tr]
invoke: native command JSON; invocation: persisted receipt query JSON.
cli.help.modelsInvocation.after:
deckent models invoke|invocation --input <file|-> [--json] [--lang en|tr]
invoke: native command JSON; invocation: persisted receipt query JSON. Both require an explicitly started local `deckent runtime serve`. A runtime-owned invocation continues if the client disconnects; retrying the same command identity returns its receipt and does not resend the native request.

models.invocation.responded.after: native response content retained separately from the receipt

models.invocation.respondedPurged.after: native response received; response content has been purged

models.invocation.rejected.after: rejection content retained separately from the receipt; counts toward the total call quota

models.invocation.rejectedPurged.after: rejection received; response content has been purged; counts toward the total call quota

models.invocation.unknownPurged.after: outcome unknown; response content has been purged

models.invocation.notice.before: Provider evidence only; this does not accept a task or confirm cost. Inspect native output with --json.
models.invocation.notice.after: A received native response or rejection is evidence only; it is neither task acceptance nor a billing determination. This invocation counts toward the total call quota; retry the same command identity to return its receipt without resending. Response content, if captured, is retained separately from the receipt and withheld by default. JSON includeResponseContent additionally requires inspect-content permission; human output never shows retained response content.

mcp.tool.inspectModelInvocation.before: Inspect a persisted model invocation with current authorization.
mcp.tool.inspectModelInvocation.after: Inspect a persisted model invocation with current authorization. It requires an explicitly started local `deckent runtime serve`; a runtime-owned invocation continues if the client disconnects. Response content is withheld by default; JSON includeResponseContent additionally requires inspect-content permission, and human output never shows retained response content.

cli.help.modelsPurgeContent.after:
deckent models purge-content --input <file|-> [--json] [--lang en|tr]
Purges active retained native, usage, or raw response content after separate purge-content policy authorization. It preserves the invocation outcome, quota record, and no-resend identity.

models.invocation.purgeNotice.after: Logical purge does not erase write-ahead logs, media, or backups.

models.invocation.noticePurged.after: A received native response or rejection is evidence only; it is neither task acceptance nor a billing determination. This invocation counts toward the total call quota; retry the same command identity to return its receipt without resending. Response content has been logically purged; human output never shows response content.

mcp.tool.purgeModelInvocationContent.after: Purge active retained native, usage, or raw response content by exact command identity and expected content digest. Requires the local runtime service and separate purge-content policy authorization. It preserves the invocation outcome, quota record, and no-resend identity; logical purge does not erase write-ahead logs, media, or backups.

mcp.tool.invokeModel.before: Submit one native model request using the configured profile and durable command identity. Complete result capacity is checked before a new call. A response is provider evidence, not task acceptance.
mcp.tool.invokeModel.after: Submit one native model request using the configured profile and durable command identity. It requires an explicitly started local `deckent runtime serve`; a runtime-owned invocation continues if the client disconnects. Retrying the same command identity returns its receipt and does not resend the native request. Complete result capacity is checked before a new call. A received native response or rejection is evidence only, neither task acceptance nor a billing determination; the lifetime call is consumed.

provider_authority.limits.aborted.before: Aborted by owner — nothing was written.

provider_authority.limits.confirm.before: Apply this CAS-guarded provider_limits transition to the global config layer?

provider_authority.limits.init_desc.before: Derive and write the global `provider_limits` block for one exact provider scope (owner-confirmed)

provider_authority.limits.invalid_enforc.before: Refused: --ratio-enforcement must be enforce or observe_only.

provider_authority.limits.invalid_ratio.before: Refused: --warn-at-ratio and --block-at-ratio must be finite numbers between 0 and 1.

provider_authority.limits.needs_scope.before: Refused: an exact scope is required — pass --provider, --model, --auth-mode, --transport, --execution-backend, --execution-profile-ref, --warn-at-ratio and --block-at-ratio. A provider-limit selector is never inferred.

provider_authority.limits.opt_auth_mode.before: Exact auth mode: subscription | api | hybrid | local

provider_authority.limits.opt_block_at_r.before: Consumption ratio (0..1) at which a run is blocked (must be >= warn)

provider_authority.limits.opt_endpoint_r.before: Optional opaque SHA-256 endpoint reference (never a URL)

provider_authority.limits.opt_execution_.before: Exact execution backend: host-subprocess | docker | tmux | api | in-process
Adapter-owned execution profile reference the account authority is scoped to

provider_authority.limits.opt_model.before: Exact model api id the live limit source is asked about

provider_authority.limits.opt_provider.before: Canonical provider id the policy is authored for

provider_authority.limits.opt_ratio_enfo.before: Ratio gate mode: enforce (default) or observe_only; absolute floors and unknown evidence still fail closed

provider_authority.limits.opt_tenant.before: Tenant id the policy is authored for (solo hosts use `local`)

provider_authority.limits.opt_transport.before: Exact transport: cli | api | http | local-runtime

provider_authority.limits.opt_warn_at_ra.before: Consumption ratio (0..1) at which a run is warned

provider_authority.limits.refused.before: Refused ({reasonCode}): {detail}. No provider-limit authority was changed.

provider_authority.limits.sources_unavai.before: HOLD: no live provider evidence source authority is registered on this host, so account and quota identity cannot be observed. The policy is deliberately NOT authored from placeholder values — register a live evidence source bundle first.

xverify.remedy.provider_authority_unavai.before: Missing authority: the provider-limit authority runtime. Author the provider_limits envelope (owner config) so the runtime opens, then retry.

doctor.provider_limit_authority_absent.before: No owner-authored provider_limits block in the global config layer — the composition holds with provider-authority-unavailable. Remedy: `deckent provider-authority limits init` (never `keyring init`; the keyring is a different authority).

doctor.provider_limit_authority_authored.before: provider_limits block exists but carries zero policies (authored-empty) — the validator refuses it and the composition still holds. Complete authoring with `deckent provider-authority limits init`.

doctor.provider_limit_authority_ok.before: Authored global provider_limits present ({policies} policy(ies)) — the xverify/execution composition can resolve limit scope.

Chat turns are governed model invocations through the local runtime service (`deckent runtime
    serve`) for the model named in `terminal.chat`. session is line mode and also reads piped
    input; workline needs an interactive terminal on stdin and stdout.

    starts one in the background; it keeps running after exit (`deckent runtime shutdown`).

Her sonucu inceleyin: denied, unavailable, unresolved ve not-dispatched sonlanmayı doğrulamaz. terminal, kayıtlı süreç çıkışıdır; iş kabulü veya etkilerin geri alınması değildir. Teslim şeması 2 kalıcı deneme sayısı, durum ve nextEligibleAt içerir; tekrar çağrı yalnız zamanı gelen kayıtları yapılandırılmış sınırlar içinde yeniden teslim eder. Bu komut arka plan daemon kurmaz.

Girişim için güncel reconcile izni gerekir. Worker başlatmaz, tekrar çalıştırmaz, iptal etmez veya silmez. Bulunamayan ya da çalışan worker belirsiz kalır; terminal süreç çıkışıdır, iş kabulü, çıktı kurtarma veya etkilerin geri alınması değildir. Güncel yürütme ayarları değişse de kalıcı kayıttaki profili kullanır. Envanterde sonlanma kanıtı yoksa kullanın; engellenmiş girişim engellenmiş kalır. Attempt için güncel reconcile izni gerekir. Worker başlatmaz, tekrar çalıştırmaz, iptal etmez veya silmez. Kullanım: deckent models [--json] [--lang en|tr] [--no-color]
